title: What the fastest-growing startups hire first
summary: Engineers come first at almost every breakout startup. What Vanta, Ramp, Stripe and others hired next shows how to plan your 2027 hiring.
body_markdown:
If you're planning 2027 hiring before the holidays, look at how some of the best-known startups built their first teams.


Almost all of them started with engineers. The hires right after that varied, and each one shows what the company believed it needed to win.
